title: Prime Minister shares an article by Hon’ble President Smt. Droupadi Murmu highlighting teaching as the sacred task of shaping humanity
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, has shared an article written by the Hon’ble President of India, Smt. Droupadi Murmu.
The Prime Minister noted that the Hon'ble President writes that teachers shape destinies by instilling knowledge, skills, values and motivation. He added that the article highlights teaching as the sacred task of shaping humanity, encouraging independent thinking and curiosity, while calling on teachers to guide students to be good human beings who uphold cultural heritage, a scientific outlook, the ideal of Antyodaya, environmental protection and “Nation First.”
The Prime Minister’s Office posted on X:
“Hon'ble President Smt. Droupadi Murmu Ji writes that teachers shape destinies by instilling knowledge, skills, values and motivation.
She highlights teaching as the sacred task of shaping humanity, encouraging independent thinking and curiosity.
She calls on teachers to guide students to be good human beings who uphold cultural heritage, a scientific outlook, the ideal of Antyodaya, environmental protection and "Nation First."”
